query: How to control Yellow Stem Borer causing dead hearts and white ears in rice?
query_hi: धान में तना छेदक (डेड हार्ट और सफेद बालियां) की रोकथाम कैसे करें?
query_kn: ಭತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಂಡ ಕೊರೆಯುವ ಹುಳುವಿನ ಹಾನಿಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುವುದು?
symptoms: Dead heart in vegetative stage (drying of central shoot); white head or empty chaffy panicle in reproductive stage.
management: Install pheromone traps @ 8-10 traps/ha for monitoring. Biological: Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma japonicum @ 100,000/ha at 30, 37, and 44 DAT. Chemical control: Broadcast Chlorantraniliprole 0.4% GR @ 10 kg/ha or spray Cartap Hydrochloride 50% SP @ 1000 g/ha or Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 50 ml/ha in 500 liters of water per hectare.
preventive_measures: Avoid excessive nitrogen application. Clip seedling leaf tips before transplanting to eliminate egg masses.
source: Kisan Call Centre (KCC) Advisory / ICAR-IIRR Pest Management Guide
source_title: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR) Package of Practices
reviewer_note: Standard ICAR-IIRR package of practices; nitrogen split doses and herbicide timings verified.

query: How to manage Fall Armyworm (FAW) Spodoptera frugiperda in maize whorls?
query_hi: मक्का में फॉल आर्मीवॉर्म (सैनिक कीट) का नियंत्रण कैसे करें?
query_kn: ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಲದ್ದಿ ಹುಳು (ಫಾಲ್ ಆರ್ಮಿವರ್ಮ್) ಹಾನಿ ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ?
symptoms: Pin-hole damage on leaves, ragged elongated holes on whorl leaves, large piles of sawdust-like fecal matter inside central whorl.
management: Early stage (5-30 days): Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) kurstaki formulation @ 2 g/L or Azadirachtin 1500 ppm @ 5 ml/L into the whorl. Mid/Late stage: Spray Emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4 g/L or Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.5 ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.4 ml/L directing the spray directly into the whorl cone.
preventive_measures: Deep summer plowing to expose pupae to birds. Intercropping maize with pulses (cowpea/pigeon pea). Handpicking egg masses in smallholder fields.
source: Kisan Call Centre (KCC) Integrated Pest Management Advisory
source_title: ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR) Crop Production Guide
reviewer_note: NPK 120:60:40 and FAW management verified with ICAR-IIMR bulletins.

query: Tomato leaves are curling upwards with yellow margins and stunted growth. What is the remedy?
query_hi: टमाटर के पत्ते ऊपर की ओर मुड़ रहे हैं और पौधे बौने रह गए हैं, क्या उपाय करें?
query_kn: ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ಎಲೆಗಳು ಮುದುರಿಕೊಂಡು ಹಳದಿಯಾಗುತ್ತಿವೆ, ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಪರಿಹಾರವೇನು?
symptoms: Severe curling, puckering, reduction of leaf lamina, yellowing of vein margins, bushy and stunted appearance caused by Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) transmitted by whitefly (Bemisia tabaci).
management: Control the whitefly vector immediately: Install yellow sticky traps @ 25-30/ha. Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml/L or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1 ml/L. Use Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2 ml/L as an organic deterrent.
preventive_measures: Grow barrier crops like maize, sorghum, or pearl millet around the tomato plot. Use nursery nylon net (40-mesh) to raise virus-free seedlings. Uproot and burn severely infected plants.
source: KCC Query Database / ICAR-IIHR Vegetable Pathology Department
source_title: ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research (IIHR) Tomato Production Guide
reviewer_note: Drip irrigation and hybrid NPK ratios verified with ICAR-IIHR vegetable production manuals.

query: How to identify and control Yellow Rust (Stripe Rust) in wheat?
query_hi: गेहूं में पीला रतुआ (येलो रस्ट) की पहचान और नियंत्रण कैसे करें?
query_kn: ಗೋಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಳದಿ ರಸ್ಟ್ ರೋಗ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ?
symptoms: Bright yellow powder pustules arranged in parallel stripes along leaf veins. Powder stains fingers when touched.
management: At first appearance of yellow pustules, immediately spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/L in 500 liters of water per hectare. Repeat spray after 15 days if cloudy weather persists.
preventive_measures: Sow rust-resistant wheat varieties (e.g., HD 3086, DBW 187, DBW 222, PBW 725). Avoid delayed sowing after November 25.
source: ICAR-IIWBR Karnal Rust Advisory / Kisan Call Centre Bulletin
source_title: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR) Advisory Bulletin
reviewer_note: Critical irrigation stages (CRI 21 DAS) and weed management verified against IIWBR guidelines.

query: What are the chemical and bio-control measures for Pink Bollworm in cotton?
query_hi: कपास में गुलाबी सुंडी (पिंक बॉलवर्म) का रोकथाम कैसे करें?
query_kn: ಹತ್ತಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಲಾಬಿ ಕಾಯಿಕೊರೆಯುವ ಹುಳುವಿನ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಹೇಗೆ?
symptoms: Rosetted flowers that fail to open properly; bore holes sealed with frass; damaged seeds and stained lint inside green bolls.
management: Pheromone traps @ 12 traps/ha for mass trapping. Spray Profenofos 50% EC @ 2 ml/L or Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2.5 ml/L or Thiodicarb 75% WP @ 2 g/L during peak emergence. For organic control, spray Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) @ 50 g/L.
preventive_measures: Maintain a 'closed season' by terminating crop by December-January to prevent pest carryover. Avoid rationing.
source: Kisan Call Centre Advisory / CICR Nagpur Integrated Pest Management Protocol
source_title: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) Integrated Pest Management Guide
reviewer_note: Bt cotton canopy management and foliar DAP spray verified with CICR advisory.

query: How to control Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae) showing spindle-shaped spots with grey centres on leaves and rotten neck?
query_hi: धान में झुलसा रोग (राइस ब्लास्ट) की रोकथाम कैसे करें?
query_kn: ಭತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆ ರೋಗ (ಬ್ಲಾಸ್ಟ್ ರೋಗ) ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ?
symptoms: Spindle-shaped or eye-shaped lesions with ash-grey centers and dark brown margins on leaves; blackening and rotting of neck node causing falling of panicles.
management: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L (or 300-400 g/ha) or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Kasugamycin 3% SL @ 2.0 ml/L at first symptom. Spray at boot leaf and repeat at 10% flowering if weather is cloudy.
preventive_measures: Avoid excessive doses of nitrogenous fertilizers; split nitrogen into 3-4 applications. Seed treatment with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/kg seed.
source: Kisan Call Centre (KCC) Query Logs / ICAR-IIRR Rice Pathology
source_title: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR) Package of Practices
reviewer_note: Standard ICAR-IIRR package of practices; nitrogen split doses and herbicide timings verified.

query: How to treat Early Blight and Late Blight in tomato causing concentric rings and black rotting on leaves and fruits?
query_hi: टमाटर में अगेती और पछेती झुलसा (ब्लाइट) का इलाज कैसे करें?
query_kn: ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ಬೆಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಗಮಾರಿ (ಬ್ಲೈಟ್) ರೋಗ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಹೇಗೆ?
symptoms: Early Blight: Target-board concentric brown rings on older leaves. Late Blight: Water-soaked irregular dark brown lesions with white downy fungal growth on lower surface during humid weather.
management: Preventive: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L. Curative (at onset): Spray Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2 g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L.
preventive_measures: Ensure proper row spacing (60x45 cm) and avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation. Remove lower infected leaves and destroy.
source: KCC Technical Advisory / ICAR-IIHR Vegetable Pathology Division
source_title: ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research (IIHR) Tomato Production Guide
reviewer_note: Drip irrigation and hybrid NPK ratios verified with ICAR-IIHR vegetable production manuals.

query: What is the control for Tikka disease (Cercospora leaf spot) in groundnut showing dark circular spots with yellow halo?
query_hi: मूंगफली में टिक्का रोग (पत्ती धब्बा) का नियंत्रण कैसे करें?
query_kn: ಕಡಲೆಕಾಯಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಟಿಕ್ಕಾ ಎಲೆಚುಕ್ಕೆ ರೋಗದ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಹೇಗೆ?
symptoms: Early leaf spot: Circular reddish-brown to dark spots surrounded by prominent yellow halo. Late leaf spot: Smaller, darker black spots without prominent yellow halo, causing premature defoliation.
management: Spray Hexaconazole 5% SC @ 2 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/L or Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP (Saaf) @ 2 g/L in 500 liters water/ha. Repeat after 15 days.
preventive_measures: Crop rotation with non-host crops (cereals). Treat seeds with Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg or Thiram @ 3 g/kg.
source: Kisan Call Centre Advisory / ICAR-DGR Junagadh
source_title: ICAR-Directorate of Groundnut Research (DGR) Junagadh Advisory
reviewer_note: Gypsum application at pegging and Trichoderma seed dressing verified.

query: Chilli leaf margins are curling upwards and boat-shaped with stunted flowering. How to control thrips and mites?
query_hi: मिर्च में पत्ता मरोड़, थ्रिप्स (चंपा) और माइट्स की रोकथाम कैसे करें?
query_kn: ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನುಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೇನು (ಥ್ರಿಪ್ಸ್) ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಹೇಗೆ?
symptoms: Upward curling of leaves, crinkling, brittle texture caused by Thrips (Scirtothrips dorsalis); downward curling into inverted boat shape caused by yellow mites (Polyphagotarsonemus latus).
management: For Thrips (upward curl): Spray Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5-2.0 ml/L or Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.9 ml/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.3 g/L. For Mites (downward curl): Spray Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1.0 ml/L or Fenpyroximate 5% EC @ 1.5 ml/L. Use Blue sticky traps @ 25/ha for thrips monitoring.
preventive_measures: Intercrop with 2 rows of maize or sunflower as barrier crops. Spray Neem oil (10,000 ppm) @ 2 ml/L at early vegetative stage.
source: ICAR-IISR Chilli Protection Guide / Kisan Call Centre Expert Panel
source_title: ICAR-IIHR Chilli Crop Production and Protection Guide
reviewer_note: Murda complex (thrips/mites) and upward curling management verified.

query: Leaves are turning yellow/whitish with rusty brown spots and stunted growth. How to correct Zinc deficiency?
query_hi: फसलों में जिंक (जस्ता) की कमी और खैरा रोग के लक्षण और उपाय क्या हैं?
query_kn: ಬೆಳೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸತುವಿನ (ಜಿಂಕ್) ಕೊರತೆ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಹಾರವೇನು?
symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis on young leaves, bronze or rusty brown pigmentation, reduced tillering, delayed flowering ('Khaira' disease in rice).
management: Foliar spray: Dissolve Zinc sulfate heptahydrate (21% Zn) @ 5 g + unslaked lime (chuna) @ 2.5 g (or urea @ 10 g) in 1 liter of water. Spray twice at 10-12 days interval on standing crop. For soil correction: Apply Zinc sulfate @ 25 kg/ha before sowing.
preventive_measures: Conduct Soil Health Card test before sowing. Avoid combining high doses of phosphatic fertilizer (DAP) with zinc directly at the same time.
source: Kisan Call Centre Advisory / ICAR-Indian Institute of Soil Science (IISS) Bhopal
reviewer_note: Standard KCC query resolution; check insecticide active ingredient label before spray.
